title: Word Ladder · Together
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Word Ladder · Together with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Write two three-letter words that can be linked by changing one letter at a time, such as cat and dog. The lead writes a chain of real three-letter words, changing one letter at each step. The chain reaches the target and every step changes exactly one letter. Play eight turns in total, rotating the lead. The group wins together if at least five turns succeed.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Word Ladder, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
The chain reaches the target and every step changes exactly one letter.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: The chain reaches the target and every step changes exactly one letter.
